meta.title: Dossier 0.7.2
meta.lede: A maintenance release: every npm package now publishes through trusted publishing with provenance, and nothing else changes. Every gate passed, and the call is ship.

parts.markdown: 0.7.2 moves the last seven npm packages off a publish token. The binary, the page, and the studio are the same as in 0.7.1.

parts.title: Changes
rows: All eight packages publish only from the release workflow through trusted publishing, with signed provenance, and disallow tokens.

items.title: Go checks
items.summary: Formatting, vet, staticcheck, errcheck, the race-enabled tests, and a CGO-free build all passed.

facets.label: How checked
facets.markdown: `make check` in `core`, which also drift-checks generated code and the vendored Graphviz.

facets.label: Result
facets.markdown: Every package passed. The reader is 20,257 bytes of its 20,480 byte budget and the stylesheet 29,106 of 30,720.

items.title: Showcase fixtures
items.summary: All seven example documents build with no warnings and match their HTML and Markdown goldens.

facets.label: How checked
facets.markdown: `TestExamples` and `TestExampleReplies` build the showcase the way a reader gets it and paste a reply into each decision document.

facets.label: Result
facets.markdown: Seven documents, six kinds, no warnings, and the largest page at 110 KB of its 120 KB budget.

items.title: 0.6 imports
items.summary: All 17 legacy fixtures upgrade to models that pass the strict 0.7 checks.

facets.label: How checked
facets.markdown: `TestLegacyFixtures` upgrades each 0.6 document and compares it with its golden.

facets.label: Result
facets.markdown: 17 of 17 upgrade strictly onto their kinds' vocabularies.

items.title: React package tests
items.summary: The wrapper renders through the binary, and the reader agrees with Go on every shared reply case.

facets.label: How checked
facets.markdown: `npm test` in `packages/react`, including the 15 reply cases shared with the Go parser.

items.title: Distribution dry run
items.summary: Six archives, their checksums, the Homebrew formula, and seven npm packages build and install.

facets.label: How checked
facets.markdown: `make dist-check` cross-compiles every target, runs the formula's test commands on an archive, and installs the npm packages from tarballs.

facets.label: Result
facets.markdown: Every check printed ok, and the binary and the launcher both report 0.7.2.

items.title: npm trusted publishing
items.summary: Every package trusts only this repository's release workflow, and no token can publish.

facets.label: How checked
facets.markdown: On npmjs.com, each of the eight packages names `kylebegeman/dossier` and `release.yml` as its trusted publisher and disallows tokens. The repository holds no npm token secret.

facets.label: Result
facets.markdown: Set up for all eight after 0.7.1. This release is the first to publish every package this way.

parts.markdown: 0.7.2 changes only how the packages are published, so 0.7.1 is an equal choice for any project.
